Most Android TV and Google TV devices restrict the Home button to the manufacturer\'s built-in home screen. Choose one of the following methods to set Glass TV as the default launcher:
Run this command from a PC or ADB tool: adb shell cmd package set-home-activity com.gathin.tvhome/.MainActivity%1$s
If the TV still restricts the Home button, disable the previous launcher: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 %1$s
